footnote_text: This restricted stock award consists of shares of common stock of the Company (the "Restricted Shares"). The Restricted Shares were granted pursuant to the Company's 2024 Non-Employee Director Long Term Incentive Plan (the "Plan") and are subject to a Restriction Period beginning on the grant date and ending on the first anniversary of the grant; or, if earlier than the first anniversary of the grant, on the date of the Company's annual stockholder meeting that next follows after the date that the Award was granted.
